Wings of Freedom Emblem artwork, crafted on 2.5mm original clear glass with a mirror-like glossy, reflective finish. Each piece is precision printed and sealed for vibrant, long-lasting color and comes with pre-installed nano tape for effortless, damage-free mounting.

Available in multiple sizes and frame color options to match any space. A striking addition for any anime fan's collection.

specifications.finish: Mirror like Glossy and Reflective Finishing
specifications.mounting: Pre-installed Nano tape FREE with each poster
specifications.dimensions: Small (8" x 12") | Medium (12" x 18") | Large (18" x 24")
